post.description: Operator/admin only. Authenticated user and server entry time are recorded. A supplied hash is manually provided; comparison never verifies the appliance. No configuration revision change.

patch.description: Operator/admin only. At least one declaration field, current expected_revision and nonblank reason required. Original operator/entry time preserved. Before/after and correction actor recorded atomically in audit. No DELETE.

get.description: Latest manually declared successful event by occurred_at, created_at, UUID descending. Backdated entries allowed; failed/cancelled/planned and downloads never select a baseline.
Read-only history for a firewall visible to the current user. Snapshot data is retrieved separately in detail.
